entries.text: 洛托洛托洛托……
entries.label: team_0090_system_01

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從皮拿那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02a

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從秋明那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02b

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從奧爾迪加那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02c

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從梅洛可那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02d

entries.text: 看來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳從枇琶那裡拿到\n老大之證團隊徽章了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_02e

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n閣道二小隊就會瀕臨瓦解了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04a

entries.text: 這麼一來，相信失去老大的\n策星小隊將會走向毀滅。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04b

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n閣道三小隊就要結束了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04c

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n王良四小隊應該就會消失了……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04d

entries.text: 這麼一來，失去老大的\n王良一小隊距離解散不遠了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_04e

entries.text: 終於，\n剩下最後１個老大……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_07

entries.text: 作戰之所以進行得順利，\n全都要歸功於[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_08

entries.text: 聶凱作為協助者，\n也表現得相當出色。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_09

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n聶凱說你們原本就認識了，\r\n你們已經認識很久了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_10

entries.text: 很久了
entries.label: team_0090_select_01

entries.text: 還不久
entries.label: team_0090_select_02

entries.text: 不論如何，真是可靠的朋友。\n就好像以前的大家一樣……[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_11

entries.text: 以前？
entries.label: team_0090_select_03

entries.text: 大家？
entries.label: team_0090_select_04

entries.text: ……[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳應該知道天星隊是由以前\n在學校被霸凌的學生們組成的吧？[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_12

entries.text: 在天星隊組成不久之後，\n老大們和霸凌其他人的學生們\r\n展開全面對決。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_13

entries.text: 結果，\n天星隊大獲全勝……\r\n不，那甚至稱不上是對決。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_14

entries.text: ……因為愛霸凌的學生們\n全都放棄了戰鬥。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_15

entries.text: 害怕天星隊的他們，\n一個接一個地退學了。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_16

entries.text: 這也導致了天星隊成員們\n給周圍留下了很糟糕的印象。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_17

entries.text: ……看來我說了些不必要的話。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_19

entries.text: 關於約定好的報酬，\n我把ＬＰ儲值到[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的手機吧。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_20

entries.text: 可以用招式學習器機製作的\n招式學習器種類變多了！
entries.label: team_0090_system_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳好好運用招式學習器吧。\n剩下的老大也交給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了。\r\n……追加報酬記得跟補給班拿。[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0090_cassiopeia_18

entries.text: 啊嗄嘶！
entries.label: team_0090_legend_01

entries.text: 嗚哇哇！\n你不要出來！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_02

entries.text: ……哦～\n天星隊曾經有過那些事啊。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_04

entries.text: 他們明明想撲滅霸凌，\n結果自己卻成了大家害怕的對象……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_05

entries.text: 真是太搞笑了。\n老師和學生通通都是笨蛋。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_06

entries.text: 當大家正在被霸凌的時候，\n要是有其他任何一個人察覺到……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_07

entries.text: 應該馬上就會明白\n天星隊才不是壞蛋……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_08

entries.text: 在那樣通通都是笨蛋的學校裡，\n就算去奮戰，\r\n大家也只會吃虧而已……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_09

entries.text: 那個創建什麼天星隊\n叫做真老大的人，\r\n一定也是個無可救藥的大笨蛋。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: team_0090_botan_10

entries.text: 沒那回事
entries.label: team_0090_select_05

entries.text: 是嗎？
entries.label: team_0090_select_06

entries.text: 拿去，這次的報酬。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
